# Learning goal

Be able to take a small vessel in and out of the archipelago's harbours
unsupervised: read the tide for any hour of any day, decide whether Ovray Cove
is enterable, and both read and hoist the flag code when the radio is down.
Working depth throughout — enough to act on, not enough to teach.

## Required topics

### Tides and navigation
- Rhythm of the tide, and how far high water shifts from one day to the next
- Range and the rule of twelfths
- Chart datum and the Ovray rule
- Storm surge and the Ashwind warning stages

### Harbour signals
- The six flags and what each one means
- Rules of use: reading order, forbidden pairs, half mast

### Island geography
- The five islands, and why Torvig is the gateway
- Settlements, harbours and where the tide office sits

## Out of scope

- Relief and the crater — how the archipelago came to be a drowned crater rim
  is background, and the certificate never asks for it
- Ferry timetables and passenger statistics
